I believe you mean well. I also believe history is full of good people who hid power until worse people came for it. I cannot step aside.

I buried a son in a winter famine while kings argued over tariffs. If the Heart can light cities, move water and end a siege before it begins, hiding it is not virtue. It is a choice about who is allowed to suffer.
I can explain it, but not while everyone is shouting at me. The short version is this: the storm and the beacons are the same system.
I do not deserve your trust. I know that. But if you keep me, I will spend every step from here making the knowledge useful instead of dangerous.
I have crossed worse skies than this. Secure your own gear and let my crew do theirs.
If I order them back, the Order may call me traitor. So be it. Better one traitor than another empire built around a machine nobody knows how to surrender.
